maddeler.e:
نتحاور (form VI)
# نَتَحَاوَرُ (nataḥāwaru) /na.ta.ħaː.wa.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَحَاوَرَ (taḥāwara)
# نَتَحَاوَرَ (nataḥāwara) /na.ta.ħaː.wa.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَحَاوَرَ (taḥāwara)
# نَتَحَاوَرْ (nataḥāwar) /na.ta.ħaː.war/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَحَاوَرَ (taḥāwara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
